description: Suministro y saneamiento del agua en Castilla-La Mancha is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. The portal shows the English title as "Water supply and sanitation in Castile-La Mancha" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. Its keywords include Publicidad activa, Medio ambiente, Agua. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SPREADSHEET. The listing shows 2019-11-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/es/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
